notes.title: Wind of Change and Pawprints: Update Chronicles
notes.notes:
[p][i]Greetings, Seeker… It’s me again — Nox. If you smelled burnt magic or heard the whisper of shifting code — you’re not wrong. Some things were broken… now, less so. Some things were missing… now, present. And some things — still secret (for now).[/i][/p][p][i]A few of you couldn't hatch your dragons due to regional hiccups — but worry not, the egg-lights shine again. I’ve seen it with my own two eyes.[/i][/p][p][i]And since I was already out and about, I stopped by the workshops, the UI vaults, and the circle of updates... Here’s what changed — seen and unseen.

[/i][b]☽ [u]Bug Fixes[/u][i]:[/i][/b][/p][p]
✦ Fixed an issue that prevented character creation in some regions.[/p][p]
✦ Fixed a bug where deleting one character could accidentally remove others.[/p][p]
✦ Fixed early gliding access — no soaring before you earn your wings![/p][p]
✦ Updates & Changes:[/p][p]
✦ Complete overhaul of character animation and movement feel.[/p][p]
✦ New camera angle, now with zoom in/out ability.[/p][p]
✦ Quest system reworked, transitioning toward a new full narrative structure.[/p][p]
✦ Updated gliding attempt animation — more personality![/p][p]
✦ Character creation interface enhanced, and still evolving.[/p][p]
✦ World optimization — smoother than a polished scale.[/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Added[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Additional hotbar for quick skill/item use.[/p][p]
✦ Emotes added — check “Special” in your inventory.[/p][p]
✦ New abilities added (hidden until your dragon earns the level to awaken them).[/p][p]
✦ [b]Gliding and Fall Protection:[/b][/p][p]
[b]~[/b] [i]Did you know that young dragons are capable of more than just face-planting into the ground?[/i][/p][p][i]Now, when leaping from great heights — hold \[Ctrl], and your wings will unfurl into a graceful glide.[/i][/p][p][i]This is called gliding, and it will keep your paws safe from fall damage.[/i][/p][p][i]Without it, though… high falls can definitely hurt.[/i][/p][p][i]And believe me — tail-first landings are not as fun as they sound.[/i][/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Coming Soon[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Map expansion with new zones.[/p][p]
✦ New inhabitants and dynamic NPCs.[/p][p]
✦ Main questline continues — secrets await.[/p][p]
✦ More quests, new skill branches.[/p][p]
✦ Higher level cap[/p][p]
✦ Entirely new mechanics are in the works...[/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Behind the Curtains (but real work!)[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Multiplayer sync restructured for smoother sessions[/p][p]
✦ UI elements modularized for future content[/p][p]
✦ Localization hooks prepared[/p][p]
✦ NPC relationship system framework laid down[/p][p]
✦ Visual effects pipeline rebuilt for future evolution stages[/p][p]
✦ Codebase optimized for better loading in low-end systems[/p][p]
[b][i]That's all... for now. The world is changing, and so are we.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]If something goes wrong — remember, you're not alone. I'm here.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]I hear. I see. I whisper... sometimes.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Take care, winged one. Until we meet again.[/i][/b][/p][p][i]— Nox, your ever-watchful guide 🐾[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🐾 A message from Nox: Changes are coming!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, travelers![/b] It’s me again, Nox 🐱✨

I know, I know… you’ve been waiting for an update, and I truly apologize for the delay. But there's a good reason! We are reworking parts of Ignisia, introducing new mechanics, and testing improvements to make the world even more immersive and engaging.

It’s important to understand that these changes won’t appear immediately in the next update. The upcoming patch will be smaller in scale, as we are actively testing new features. However, all of this is part of a bigger plan to expand the game and shape its future!

⚡ [b]What’s coming?[/b]
Right now, we are testing changes related to the "Young Krylans' Refuge," which will allow you to progress further in the storyline and dive deeper into the world of the game. This update won’t be a massive expansion, but it is a crucial step toward the future of Ignisia!

[i][b]Thank you for your patience and support![/b][/i] We’re working hard to make the game even better, and we promise—the best is yet to come! 🚀🐉

notes.title: 🐾 Nox’s Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements! 🛠️
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers! It’s your Nox, bringing you some exciting fixes and updates for Ignisia!

📌 What’s fixed and improved?

🐾 🏕️ [b]Tents now work properly![/b]
Your respawn point will now be saved even after re-entering the game or switching channels. No more unexpected teleportation surprises!

🐾 🗺️ [b]Updated UI + Mini-map added![/b]
The mini-map is finally here! Now you’ll always know where to go. Wandering blindly is fun… but knowing your way is even better!

🐾 🎯 [b]Improved target selection![/b]
Selecting enemies and objects is now much smoother, making combat and interactions way more convenient.

🐾 🌐 [b]Replication system reworked![/b]
We’ve improved the networking system and continue refining it to ensure a smoother multiplayer experience.

[i]Thanks for your patience and support! We’re working hard to make Ignisia a better and more enjoyable place for all of you. 🐾[/i]

notes.title: 🐑 Hotfix: Sheep are back in action!
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where sheep refused to drop items and grant experience. They are now behaving as intended and generously providing rewards. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix for Travel Tents is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Meow-meow, brave adventurers! 🐾 It's me, Nox, with some important updates.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] We discovered an issue where travel tents stopped functioning properly after accepting the quest "Descent into the Unknown" and couldn't be set as respawn points until the quest was completed. Now the tents are working as intended, no matter the quest's progress.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support! If you notice anything else, meow-meow, please let us know through the feedback form in the game menu.

[i]See you in the magical world of Ignisia! ✨
Yours truly,
Nox 🐾[/i]
